gufoshapes.note: This is gufoshapes as shipped inside the gUFO pin, not the separate nemo-ufes/gufoshapes repository pin used in the October 2026 Turtle round-trip check.

tools.pyshacl: pyshacl 0.40.2 (advanced, inference none; data = gufo.ttl + output)

reasons.ANNOTATION: Human annotations (rdfs:label/rdfs:comment). OntoGraph labels are the OntoUML element names; upstream prose comments are not in the model.
reasons.AXIOM-FORM-DIFFERENCE: Same logical content in a different OWL form (pairwise owl:disjointWith vs owl:AllDisjointClasses, disjointWith direction, blank-node shape of an identical restriction).
reasons.ENTAILED-BY-ONTOGRAPH: An upstream axiom or fact that OntoGraph states differently: Pellet (OntoGraph pinned bridge) shows OntoGraph output + gufo.ttl entails it.
reasons.INSTANCE-NOT-IN-PROSE: Individual (or fact about one) that appears only in the upstream Turtle; the page prose does not state it, so it was not modelled.
reasons.INVALID-CASE-SCOPE: The OntoGraph invalid case extends the full valid model with the pitfall; the upstream invalid file is a minimal excerpt.
reasons.ONTOLOGY-HEADER: Ontology header: ontology IRI, owl:imports target or ontology annotations.
reasons.ONTOUML-STEREOTYPE-REQUIRED: OntoUML requires a stereotype on every class; OntoGraph projects it as the gUFO metaclass while upstream leaves the class untyped.
reasons.REVIEWED-MODELLING-DIFFERENCE: A genuine content difference, reviewed and recorded with a note in reviewed-differences.v1.json.
reasons.STRUCTURALLY-EQUAL: A blank-node structure (list, restriction, anonymous individual) that is isomorphic on both sides; RDF canonical labels differ only because neighbouring annotations differ.
reasons.UFO-DERIVED-AXIOM: Extra axiom produced by an OntoGraph mapping rule from UFO (kind disjointness, parthood irreflexivity/asymmetry, multiplicity) that upstream does not state.
